actions.reason: Reuse the model-save prefix cache to carry the corresponding parsed merge and vocabulary data. When saving an extending merge sequence, the load cache entry can be built by copying the cached prefix state and adding only the new suffix merges instead of reconstructing all merge and vocab entries from scratch.
